title: Parameters
subtitle: Email, object storage, and AI assistant service configuration. System admins only.

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.hint: Choose the Carbon color theme for the interface, or follow your operating system's color scheme. Saved in this browser only.
appearance.label: Theme

mail.heading: Email service
mail.hint: SMTP sending configuration. Currently only stored; sending is not wired up yet.

storage.heading: Object storage
storage.hint: S3-compatible storage (Tencent COS, Alibaba OSS, MinIO, etc.) configuration. Currently only stored; uploads are not wired up yet.
storage.usePathStyle: Path-style access (for MinIO and other self-hosted)

ai.heading: AI assistant
ai.hint: Large-model API configuration (OpenAI-compatible). The key is stored only on the backend and never sent to the browser; once enabled, the “AI assistant” permission controls who can use it.
